# fyre_user (Data Source)

Fetches user details for the authenticated user, including authentication status, email, login information, and development/sentry details.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `authenticated` (Boolean) Whether the user is authenticated
- `client_ip` (String) Client IP address
- `development` (Attributes) Development environment details (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--development))
- `email` (String) User's email address
- `full_name` (String) User's full name
- `id` (String) The user ID if one is returned
- `login` (String) User's login identifier
- `login_expiration` (Number) Login expiration timestamp
- `programs` (List of String) List of programs the user has access to
- `sentry` (Attributes) Sentry authentication details (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sentry))
- `site` (String) Site location where user details were fetched from
- `unix_expiration_timestamp` (Number) Unix timestamp for expiration
